compiler_boundary.native_return: The six-argument foreign entry returns u64. Reject nonzero high32 wrapper status before interpreting low32 Core extent or error; never truncate first.
compiler_boundary.seed_capacity_scope: The 1 MiB capacity is established only for the compiler-None foreign-wrapper build branch. These individual frames fit it; this is not a global native-capacity claim.

integer_encoding: All fields are complete unsigned 64-bit little-endian words. Validate before narrowing. There is no version word. v8 byte loads/stores assemble words; no v9 word-memory instruction is used.

source_frame.payload_encoding: Complete valid UTF-8. A frame may not begin or end inside a codepoint. Validation covers the entire payload before any store.

validation: Each field is a full unsigned 64-bit word. active/detect/call_open must be 0 or 1; last_text_kind is 0 none/barrier, 1 Normal, 2 Delta.
Between public calls call_open=0 and last_text_kind=0. With call_open=1, nonzero last_text_kind must agree with active (1 with inactive, 2 with active).
detect=1 requires prefix_id in 0..30 and checked leading_bytes+prefix_length+trailing_bytes=pending_bytes. prefix_id=0 requires trailing_bytes=0, so all pending bytes are leading whitespace.
Push source extent must equal 88+payload_bytes, length<=4096, flags in 0..3; first flag requires call_open=0, non-first requires call_open=1. Complete valid UTF-8 is validated before any store.
Push requires pending_bytes+payload_bytes to fit u64. This ensures all possible per-frame leading/trailing/pending increments fit; no aggregate application limit is imposed on the Host String domain.
Finish/Inspect require source extent=88, flags=0, payload_bytes=0, call_open=0 and last_text_kind=0.

At the end of a final Push frame clear call_open/last_text_kind; otherwise return call_open=1 with HIA-owned last_text_kind. Empty Push with first|final is legal, does not finish or release buffered input.
These validate structural state, not historical authenticity of arbitrary raw supplied state. Host binds pending_bytes to its complete pending container on every call.
state.pending_container: The Host retains the entire unbounded pending String. Each frame binds its byte length to pending_bytes. HIA retains only the numeric prefix/whitespace state; no Host recognizer or historical-authenticity claim is introduced.

operations.name: Push
operations.payload: 0..4096 complete UTF-8 bytes, all consumed in order exactly once.
operations.public_call: First flag requires call_open=0; absent first requires call_open=1. Final flag clears call_open and last_text_kind after all records; otherwise preserve HIA last and return call_open=1. Empty first|final is legal without flushing.

operations.name: Finish
operations.effect: Resolve any nonempty pending line without appending LF, then emit End if still active. Reset all state to the exact initial vector. Repeated Finish is empty; later Push remains valid.

operations.name: Inspect
operations.effect: Return exactly the same eight logical state words, with zero commands and reserved zero. Preserve the Host pending String; no parsing or state transition.

output_frame.return_value: Exact written extent 80+32*command_count; every byte beyond that extent retains its original fill.

commands.name: AppendInput
commands.fields: offset/length identify a nonempty whole-scalar range in this payload; continue_text=0
commands.effect: Append bytes to Host pending container, no public output.

commands.name: FlushNormal
commands.effect: Move all pending bytes into original TaggedLineSegment::Normal, then clear pending. Do not construct visible_text here.

commands.name: FlushDelta
commands.effect: Move all pending bytes into original TaggedLineSegment::TagDelta(PlanTag::ProposedPlan, text), then clear pending.

commands.name: DropPending
commands.effect: Discard only the explicitly commanded pending bytes.

commands.name: InputNormal
commands.fields: offset/length identify a nonempty whole-scalar range in this payload;continue_text=0 or1
commands.effect: Append explicit input bytes into original TaggedLineSegment::Normal. Do not construct visible_text here.

commands.name: InputDelta
commands.fields: offset/length identify a nonempty whole-scalar range in this payload;continue_text=0 or1
commands.effect: Append explicit input bytes into original TaggedLineSegment::TagDelta(PlanTag::ProposedPlan, text).

command_canonicalization: Each whole input UTF-8 scalar emits exactly one AppendInput or InputNormal/InputDelta record. Flush/Drop/Start/End each occupy their own record. Never coalesce adjacent command records. Only HIA continue_text controls public Normal/Delta segment merging.
input_partition: AppendInput and InputNormal/InputDelta offsets start at zero and advance continuously, without omission, overlap or replay, over the entire payload. Other commands consume no input. Each range covers one complete scalar.

capacity.rule: These conservative thresholds are normative even when the actual record count is smaller. Full invalidity preflight precedes SHORT. Success returns exact output EOF, not reserved capacity.
capacity.proof: Push emits at most Append+Drop+Start/End, three commands per scalar and therefore at most 3*N commands. Finish emits at most Drop+Start+End. Each command is 32 bytes after the 80-byte header.

statuses.success: Exact output extent at least80 and at most393296.

precedence: complete structural and UTF-8 INVALID checks
INVALID_conditions: Source shorter than the complete header, incorrect exact source extent, unknown op, noncanonical full-width flags/state/prefix/call fields, payload over 4096, Finish/Inspect payload or flags, malformed UTF-8, and any required state/count overflow.

Validate full u64 values before every narrowing or address calculation. Guard leading+prefix+trailing and pending+N with safe comparison/subtraction before checked additions, returning INVALID rather than allowing a checked-arithmetic trap.
Input byte length must be between88 and4184 before any header load. Known op, canonical flags/state words and N<=4096 precede any narrowing.
For detect=1, compare leading<=pending, subtract leading, compare prefix_length<=remainder, then require trailing equals the residual. No overflowing sum is evaluated.
For Push, compare payload_bytes<=u64::MAX-pending_bytes before incrementing any pending/whitespace count. Finish/Inspect have zero payload, so the same guarded comparison is harmless.
Reject isolated continuation bytes, C0/C1/F5..FF leads, truncated sequences, malformed continuation bytes, overlong encodings, surrogate scalars and values above U+10FFFF.
validation_and_errors.SHORT_condition: Every source/state/UTF-8 check succeeded and supplied output capacity is below the normative threshold.
validation_and_errors.error_buffers: The entire source, output capacity and workspace, including all guards, stay byte-for-byte unchanged on INVALID or SHORT.
validation_and_errors.bounded_emission: After preflight, pending increments fit u64; offsets stay within 4096 payload bytes, prefix constants stay within15 bytes, and record indices fit the reserved output. Source must remain unchanged during the synchronous call.

markers.matching: Case-sensitive exact standalone tag line after pinned Unicode trim_start/trim_end; only LF ends a line. Opening while already active and closing while inactive remain ordinary text after the original buffering decision point.
markers.dual_prefixes: Both prefixes remain eligible regardless of active. Prefix0 is empty, prefix1 is shared less-than,2..15 are open lengths,16..30 are close lengths=id-14.

unicode_whitespace.line_termination: U+000A only. CR, NEL, line separator and paragraph separator are trim whitespace but do not independently finish a line.
unicode_whitespace.source_of_truth: Pinned Rust char::is_whitespace and str trim methods; no locale/Python classification or executed reference model.
